note: Column boxes measured off work/paper_ruler.py at 7x-9x with an 8px grid, then widened a pixel each way because the Japanese strokes overhang the column slightly and left faint marks behind.  Columns are listed right to left, the order vertical Japanese reads in.
body: Body text is left in Japanese on purpose.  It is set at about eight pixels, where neither script resolves into anything a player can read, so replacing it would swap one illegible page for another while risking the paper texture.  The headlines are set at 13 to 16 pixels and are what a player actually reads.
name: The paper prints 沼崎栄太郎.  At 16px the 栄 is easy to take for 晋, and 晋太郎 is a different character in this game, so the script settles it: 沼崎 is followed by 栄太郎 21 times and by 晋太郎 never.
